resources.string: Choose an on-device model to start chatting. Models with Agent Skills can take actions, and audio-capable models can answer your voice or transcribe recordings.
This model supports conversation. Choose an Agent Skills model from Models to use actions.
Chat, use your voice, and ask Agent Skills to help with actions.
Ask a question, work through an idea, or ask me to take action. Agent Skills are here when you need them.
Use the microphone to talk to the model or transcribe audio.
